story.head: The Capitals roll past the Flyers
paras: Travis Konecny got the scoring started for the Flyers just 17 seconds into the game, but Ryan Leonard tied it up for Washington a little over three minutes later. Cole Hutson gave the Capitals the lead on the power play midway through the second. Boone Jenner pushed the lead to 3-1 late in the period. The Caps scored four times in the third. Rasmus Ristolainen pulled the Flyers within one early in the third. Alex Tuch added insurance with just under three minutes left, his fourth straight game with a goal. Matt Roy added an empty-net goal with less than three minutes left to make it 5-2, and Ivan Miroshnichenko made it 6-2 with a little over a minute left. Cole Knuble made it 6-3 with 42 seconds left. Dylan Strome stretched the lead to 7-3 with 11 seconds left. Tuch finished with a goal and two assists.

The Capitals had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Flyers 35-21. Logan Thompson made 18 saves for the Capitals, and Joseph Woll allowed six goals on 34 shots. The Capitals moved to 11-11-0, sixth in the Metropolitan, while the Flyers fell to 9-12-6, fifth in the Metropolitan.

items.text: The Flyers’ three-game winning streak is over.
The Capitals won for the first time in six games.
Alex Tuch extended his point streak against Philadelphia to nine games.
